face: descriptive shadow sweep; selects no weight, changes no book, places no order
not_modelled: roll cost, margin, financing/carry, contract multipliers; ETF universe is survivors

tsmom60.note: best_sharpe_weight is IN-SAMPLE over the same window it is measured on; it is a description of the curve, not a recommended allocation

cost_breakeven_bp.note: None means the sleeve did not clear the book even at the lowest cost tested; the ladder stops at the first non-positive level

turnover_control.note: band = absolute weight change ignored inside an already-open position; entries, exits and sign flips always execute, so this measures rebalance frequency, not participation. gross_give_up_pp is what the band costs BEFORE any cost saving, and it is the honest half of the trade. structural_turnover_total is the floor no band can remove
